observations: Photo 0: A split-type air conditioner unit wrapped in plastic, with the indoor unit on top and outdoor unit below. The brand 'SAMSUNG' is visible on the indoor unit. The outdoor unit has a Samsung logo. The unit is placed on a dirt ground, with other appliances visible in the background.
Photo 1: Same unit from a slightly different angle. A remote control is placed on top of the indoor unit. The plastic wrap is intact. The outdoor unit's grille is visible.
Photo 2: Another angle of the same unit, showing the indoor unit's front panel with the Samsung logo and control buttons. The remote is still on top. The plastic wrap is still covering both units.
All photos show the unit wrapped in plastic, suggesting it is new or unused. No visible damage to the casing or components.
No model number is visible on any of the photos. The brand 'SAMSUNG' is readable on the indoor unit in all three photos.

claims.evidence: The photos show a new-looking unit wrapped in plastic, but there is no proof of arrival date or power rating. The 1.5hp claim cannot be verified from the photos.

claims.evidence: The remote is visible in photos 1 and 2. The indoor hanger, water hose, and filters are not visible in any photo. Their presence cannot be confirmed.
Subjective claim; cannot be verified from photos or text alone.

risks.risk: The unit may be used or refurbished, not new as implied by 'just arrived'.
risks.proof: A clear shot of the original packaging, serial number, or invoice showing purchase date.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used/refurbished, which reduces value significantly.

risks.risk: The 1.5hp power rating is unverified; the unit may be a lower or higher capacity model.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model number plate or rating label on the indoor or outdoor unit.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unknown capacity, which may be lower than 1.5hp, reducing value.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (indoor hanger, water hose, filters) as claimed.
risks.proof: Photos showing all accessories laid out or installed.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as missing accessories, which reduces value.

risks.risk: Unit may be damaged or non-functional despite appearance.
risks.proof: A video showing the unit powering on and cooling, or a test report from a technician.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, which reduces value to scrap or parts price.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the model number plate on the indoor or outdoor unit.
Photo showing all accessories (indoor hanger, water hose, filters) included.
Video or photo showing the unit powered on and cooling.
Photo of the original packaging or invoice to verify 'just arrived' claim.
response.reason: The brand is identifiable as Samsung, but the model number and key claims (1.5hp, accessories included, new condition) cannot be verified from the current photos. Without proof of model, accessories, and functionality, the item cannot be priced accurately. The risks of misrepresentation or missing components are significant.
